evidence: Article explains two distinct directions: device design and clinical technology management. Its prototype-testing and equipment-replacement examples make the work concrete without a photo.
Existing media.json has no engineer-specific asset. Targeted Commons/clinical-engineer search did not establish a usable licensed occupational image.
limits: Do not reuse the BMET photograph as an engineer portrait: it depicts an identified equipment technician.
A future device-design or human-factors diagram could explain engineering tradeoffs, but an unrelated device photograph is decorative and no authentic cleared diagram was selected.
recommendation: Retain a text-only draft. Its paired illustrative workdays already explain the engineering distinction; image absence alone is not a publication blocker under the project rule that visuals must deepen understanding.
